subject: Re: Briefing request — LLM POC timing
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Briefing request — LLM POC timing

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for the time last week. Based on our conversation, I put together a short 30‑minute technical briefing + walkthrough focused on inference economics and deployment options that I think will help Sasha and your infra team evaluate the integration lift.

Would any of these 30‑minute slots work next week?
- Tue 11/09, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 11/10, 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 11/11, 09:00–09:30 PT

I can have Karthik join from Solutions to cover the integration checklist and security considerations. If you prefer, we can record and share notes for the folks traveling.

If your priorities shifted and it makes more sense to revisit later, no problem — just tell me the right horizon and we’ll pause outreach.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0191

Attachments: redwood_poc-outline.pdf (8 pages) — short agenda, success criteria, data flow diagram
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@helioshealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@helioshealth.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Briefing request — LLM POC timing

Laura —

Appreciate you coordinating the options and the outline. Unfortunately, we need to pause active evaluation for the LLM POC for the remainder of Q4. Two reasons:
1) Product is frozen for the release cycle — our roadmap owner reprioritized resources to telemetry and billing features that land in mid‑December.
2) A chunk of the infra team (including Sasha) will be on site for vendor assessments and travel from 11/10–11/21.

Can we table the live briefing for now? I’d prefer we reconvene in early Q1 (first two weeks of January) after the release and travel.

If you and Karthik could send the short deck and the security FAQ, we’ll keep them on file and route to our compliance reviewer. Also, if you want to tentatively hold a January slot, we can confirm once the roadmap lock clears.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Brooks
Director, Platform Engineering | Helios Health
evan.brooks@helioshealth.com | (617) 555‑4321
